rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an indigenous person or member of a place's original people.

example.english: We met an aborigine in Australia.
example.traditional: 我哋喺澳洲識咗一位原住民。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 ou3 zau1 sik1 zo2 jat1 wai2 jyun4 zyu6 man4

rows.note: Use this especially for indigenous inhabitants of Hong Kong's New Territories or another particular area.

example.english: An aborigine from the New Territories knows this area's history very well.
example.traditional: 新界有位原居民好熟呢區嘅歷史。
example.jyutping: san1 gaai3 jau5 wai2 jyun4 geoi1 man4 hou2 suk6 ni1 keoi1 ge3 lik6 si2

rows.note: Use this more formal term when referring to an indigenous or aboriginal person in a written or descriptive context.

example.english: This report records an aborigine's life on the island.
example.traditional: 呢份報告記載咗一位島上土著嘅生活。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 gei3 zoi3 zo2 jat1 wai2 dou2 soeng6 tou2 zoek6 ge3 sang1 wut6
